author: CBR
description:
Why do great villains feel so powerful? Sierra Nutkevitch breaks down how villain motivation shapes every great story. Unlike heroes, villains are often allowed to feel everything at full volume: anger, vanity, ego, obsession, and desire. 

The best movie villains usually want one thing very badly, and that clear goal makes every choice feel sharp, dangerous, and unforgettable. From iconic villains to classic movie antagonists, this explains why a villain’s desire can make or break the story.
